[ShadowSaver] can this tab be used as an extension monitor?
[jeffr] hi
there is some software which does this.
Using Apps: You can turn your Android tablet into a second screen for a Windows PC using SuperDisplay, which connects via USB for low latency and supports pressure-sensitive styluses. Another free alternative is Spacedesk, which supports both wireless and wired USB connections.
With Spacedesk it must also be installed on the PC (which means if you have a work laptop they may/may not support it)
You can use an Android tablet as a second monitor on Windows 11 by using built-in wireless features if you have a Samsung Galaxy Tab)
